last.verdict: Teva's three growth drugs surged 33% and full-year guidance rose again, but generic declines held total revenue down 2% for the quarter.

takeaways.label: Growth brands accelerating
takeaways.text: Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy together reached about $1.1 billion, up 33%. Ajovy grew 61% and Uzedy 96%, while Austedo rose 21% to $751 million.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised again
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue outlook is now $16.7–17.0 billion, up from $16.5–16.85 billion. Ajovy guidance jumped to $930–960 million from $850–870 million; Austedo to $2.55–2.65 billion.

takeaways.label: Margins improving
takeaways.text: Adjusted gross margin rose to 58.7% from 55.3%. Adjusted EPS was $0.86 versus $0.78 a year earlier.

takeaways.label: Generics still a drag
takeaways.text: Revenue fell 2% to $4.4 billion, mainly because sales of the generic cancer drug lenalidomide dropped in the U.S.

history.verdict: Stronger brand-drug sales and raised guidance outweighed a profit miss.

reasons.label: Austedo outlook raised
reasons.text: 2026 Austedo sales guidance lifted to $2.45–2.6 billion; U.S. sales up 33%.

reasons.label: Revenue guidance raised
reasons.text: 2026 revenue outlook raised to $16.5–16.85 billion on Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy.

reasons.label: Miss blamed on deal
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of 2 cents missed; Emalex acquisition cost about 61 cents per share.
